claims.head: Watch New Jersey’s puck management
claims.body: New Jersey gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (26th of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). NY Rangers ranks 10th for chances off turnovers.

claims.head: NY Rangers hits; New Jersey mostly doesn’t
claims.body: On physicality, NY Rangers sits 3rd of 32, at the bruising end of the scale. New Jersey is 30th, at the finesse end.
